concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-partners-oauth-scopes]] — 2026-09-15 partner OAuth scope-to-API-action guide for webhooks, online payments, tokenization, raw card, payment links, account settings and Cloud device requests; token scope and merchant grant bound access.
warnings: The webhook read scope includes a POST test operation, while the accountsettings write section lists only GET /merchants/{merchantId}; retain the exact documented API actions instead of inferring methods from suffixes.
A scope identifier alone does not establish customer consent, granted merchant accounts, PCI enablement or live merchant access.
